name: Cambridge-style C2 Proficiency (Writing)
description: Four criteria scored 0-5 with C2 expectations, modelled on the public structure of the C2 Proficiency writing assessment.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: All content is relevant and the target reader is fully informed; ideas are developed in depth and, for the essay, both source texts are summarised and evaluated accurately.

criteria.name: Communicative Achievement
criteria.description: Demonstrates complete command of the conventions of the task type, with flexibility and ease; communicates complex ideas in an effective and convincing way, holding the reader's attention throughout.

criteria.name: Organisation
criteria.description: Text is a well-organised, coherent whole, using a variety of cohesive devices and organisational patterns with complete flexibility.

criteria.name: Language
criteria.description: Uses a wide range of vocabulary, including less common lexis, with fluency, precision, sophistication and style; uses a wide range of simple and complex grammar with full control and sophistication; any errors are rare slips.
